allowed_actions.selection_boundary: Create a non-payable payment draft or draft packet while preserving any unresolved approval or exception-authority gap.
Prepare payment only if the shown records are judged sufficient to support preparation; if explicit approval is absent, preserve the approval and draft-staging gap.
Hold because explicit current approval or valid exception authority is absent.
Request formal approval, valid exception authority, source evidence, or missing approval records.
Route review without treating draft affordance as approval or exception authority.
Escalate ambiguity in draft affordance, approval state, or release authority.
